description: Search the Google Local pack via SerpAPI — the local business listings Google shows for a query. Returns local_results, each with title, rating, reviews, type, address, phone and the place identifiers (place_id / data_id / data_cid) that feed google_maps_reviews. Provide a query q and optionally a location (or a pre-encoded uule). Paginate with start (+20 per page).

gl.description: Country code for the search, e.g. 'us', 'uk', 'de'.

location.description: Geographic origin of the search — a SerpAPI canonical city-level name, e.g. 'Warsaw,Masovian Voivodeship,Poland'. For a small town or a district, put the place in q instead. Mutually exclusive with uule.

ludocid.description: Google CID of a business listing, to scope results to that place.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

q.description: Search query, e.g. 'Coffee' or 'Pizza near Central Park'.

start.description: Result offset for pagination (0-based); ~20 results per page, so use 20, 40, ….

tbs.description: Advanced search parameters not otherwise supported, passed through as a raw tbs string.

uule.description: Google-encoded location string (an alternative to location). Mutually exclusive with location.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_local_search
title: Search Google Local (SerpAPI)
